## The one insufficient pair

**Order 395 never proves that any forbidden graph has the Erdős–Hajnal property.** It defines the property, refutes it for the class of all graphs, proves three invariances, states the conjecture — and stops. `ex-complete-and-empty-hereditary-classes-have-constant-one` is not this: "complete graphs have EH constant 1" says a complete graph is a clique; the real statement is "$K_t$-**free** graphs are EH", which is Ramsey's theorem and is absent.

Beta's Chudnovsky locator stops at p. 2. Page 3 opens with exactly the missing material. Three additions, all provable from published items already in closure — no `requires` change, no split (11 → 14 items):

- **$K_t$-free ⇒ EH**, from `thm-finite-graph-ramsey-binomial-bound` (I read it: $\binom{s+t-2}{s-1}\to(s,t)^2$, off-diagonal, exactly what's needed).
- **$P_3$-free ⇒ $\hom(G)\ge\sqrt n$** — every component is a clique, so $n\le\alpha\omega\le\hom^2$; `graphs-walks-and-connectivity` already supplies 14 of this page's deps.
- **Every graph on ≤ 3 vertices is EH**, from those two plus the scaffolded complement invariance.

## Riehl locators — the alarm was a false positive

Downloaded the PDF (build `D:20260728`) and read Chapter 4. §4.6 in the 2nd edition **is** "Adjunctions, limits, and colimits"; the adjoint functor theorems are Theorems 4.7.3/4.7.10/4.7.17 in §4.7, which Beta cites only for Lemma 4.7.1. Every page boundary in the locator is exact. The 12 numbers that look missing from the harvest are **displayed-equation numbers**, not environments. No first-edition locator was carried over.

Also verified against the text: MA-1 item 40 dropped to the Hom side and recorded; `def-floor-and-ceiling` genuinely does not exist in `library/`, and the drop is recorded twice; both B-leaf traps avoided by local construction; the RAPL split intact; the choice wording survived in four places, not three.

## Three corrections on batch 6 (edits, not additions — headroom untouched)

1. `cor-a-galois-connection-satisfies-fgf-equals-f-and-gfg-equals-g` asserts *equality* while depending only on a **preorder** definition. Riehl Cor. 4.2.10 says "If $A$ and $B$ are **posets**…" — without antisymmetry you get only $FGF\cong F$. Title claims more than the proof gives.
2. The ideal/variety example is *antitone* and cites the monotone `def-galois-connection`; Riehl homes it under Def. 4.4.1. Fixing it also gives `def-mutually-left-and-mutually-right-adjoint-contravariant-functors` its only consumer.
3. `ex-the-maximal-subgroupoid-and-fractions-adjoint-triple` claims a triple but has no dependency supporting the groupoid-of-fractions left adjoint, and there is no localisation page anywhere in `plan-spec.json`. Recommend narrowing to the right adjoint.

I didn't touch `plan-spec.json`.

Batch 4's induced-removal chain closes as advertised, and the tower-bound titles are honest — Zhao's Thm 2.1.17 says verbatim "We do not include the proof here", so the decline is real. One wording fix required on `rem-tower-and-wowzer-bounds-in-regularity` ("gives tower bounds" must say *upper*), and one coverage gap: Zhao Exercises 2.1.22–2.1.25 sit inside §2.1 but outside the stated locator, and 2.1.24 is the half graph the notes cite.
